verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt is live (HTTP 200) at developer.konghq.com/llms.txt and indexes Kong's developer docs for Gateway, Konnect, AI Gateway and Mesh. Doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs (e.g. gateway.md, catalog.md, dev-portal.md), which gives agents markdown-friendly docs to ingest. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of the llms.txt or agent-docs program itself (e.g. an llms-full.txt variant or usage guidance), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.
